1. Add robots.txt — Configure it correctly to guide search-engine crawlers and reference the XML sitemap. 
2. Generate an XML sitemap — Include the relevant, indexable pages on chitti.app. 
3. Return proper HTTP 404 status codes — Unknown URLs such as /blog should return a real 404 instead of serving the Nuxt app shell with status 200 (soft 404). - Already done
4. Add canonical tags — Add self-referencing canonical URLs to the Future School and workshop pages.  Ensure query parameters such as ?utm_source=gb and ?utm_source=wl do not create duplicate canonical URLs. 
5. Redirect www.chitti.app to chitti.app — Configure a permanent HTTP 301 redirect.  	Reason: The proposal found that the www host serves a duplicate copy. A permanent 301 redirect establishes one preferred host and consolidates signals instead of splitting them between versions. 
6. Standardize trailing slashes — Ensure each page has one canonical URL format, with or without a trailing slash. 
7. Pre-render the workshop landing page — Make /workshop/electronics-kit-1on1-english content available in server-rendered HTML without requiring JavaScript.  	Reason: The server currently returns only six words of meaningful content before JavaScript runs. Pre-rendering makes the workshop title, description, content and other important information available to crawlers and link-preview systems that do not execute JavaScript reliably. 
8. Add Open Graph metadata — Configure OG title, description and image for the Future School and workshop pages so shared links display correctly on WhatsApp, Facebook and other platforms. 
9. Configure page indexing intentionally — Decide whether the paid workshop landing page should be indexed or set to noindex once its organic counterpart is live and ranking. 
10. Replace JavaScript-only navigation with real anchor links — Use <a href> links for module cards, grade pages and policy pages so search engines can crawl them. 
11. Fix page titles and meta descriptions — Use keyword-led titles and descriptions of approximately 140–155 characters. 
12. Optimize image accessibility — Add meaningful alt text to images that are missing it. 
13. Lazy-load below-the-fold images — Reduce unnecessary initial page loading and image-transfer costs. 
14. Fix the region-selection experience — Replace the blocking region pop-up with automatic region pre-selection based on location and an inline region switcher. 
15. Improve workshop page performance — Reduce Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and mobile layout shift. The proposal targets LCP at or below 2.5 seconds and layout shift (CLS) at or below 0.1. 
16. Build an indexable electronics-kit page — Create /workshops/electronics-kit-for-kids/ as the organic-search counterpart to the paid workshop page.  Reason: The paid workshop page and the organic SEO page serve two different purposes. Chitti wants to sell the ₹299 electronics workshop through ads while also attracting people who search Google for electronics kits for kids. 
17. Configure Google Search Console monitoring — Use search performance data to identify queries, monitor indexing and guide new page creation.
